title: Icahn Enterprises Just Added $78 Million in Centuri Shares, but the Real Story Starts Earlier
author: Seena Hassouna
description: Icahn Enterprises increased its stake in Centuri Holdings by 3.5 million shares worth approximately $78 million in Q4 2025, bringing its total position to 14.3 million shares valued at $362 million (4.29% of AUM). This follows Icahn's earlier $75 million private placement investment in the utility infrastructure services company, signaling continued conviction in the business despite it not being a top-five holding.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock has appreciated 69.5% over the past year, outperforming S&P 500 by 46.33 percentage points. Icahn's continued investment through both private placement and open market purchases demonstrates confidence in the company's utility infrastructure services business and grid modernization exposure.

The transaction itself is routine portfolio management activity. While it shows Icahn's continued conviction in Centuri, the 4.29% position is not a defining bet for Icahn Enterprises, and the article notes this is context rather than a strong directional signal.

title: Centuri Posted Record Quarterly Revenue, So Why Did One Fund Exit a $29 Million Stake?
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: ACK Asset Management fully exited its $29.11 million stake in Centuri Holdings (1,375,000 shares) in Q4 2025, despite the company posting record quarterly revenue of $850 million (up 18.1% YoY) and achieving a record $5.9 billion backlog. The exit raises questions about valuation concerns despite strong operational metrics and 45.9% share price appreciation over the past year.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: strong operational performance (record revenue, 25% base revenue growth, record $5.9B backlog, 45.9% YoY share appreciation) contrasts with a major fund's complete exit, suggesting valuation concerns may outweigh growth visibility despite durable demand from utility modernization trends.

Mentioned as a top holding in ACK Asset Management's portfolio ($59.03M, 7.5% of AUM), indicating it remains a core industrial/materials position, but no specific news or sentiment drivers are provided in the article.

title: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz Continues Investigation of Centuri Holdings, Inc. (CTRI) on Behalf of Investors
author: Prnewswire
description: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz is investigating Centuri Holdings, Inc. (CTRI) for possible violations of federal securities laws.
